Overview of Daejeon Region (Daejeon)

Daejeon Region (Daejeon) is located in the Daejeon region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Daejeon. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail.

RegionDaejeon
Capital cityDaejeon
Cities & municipalities11
Primary transport hubDaejeon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Daejeon Region

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Daejeon

When visiting cities across Daejeon, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli

Best time to visit Daejeon

Best time to visit Daejeon: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
